events.text: That movement turns the museum outward toward the city around it.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The stories ask readers to connect a benefit with the conditions sustaining it.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Their concrete encounters keep complexity from becoming another reason to stop looking.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Necessity, care, contracts, and future benefits give the museum powerful explanatory language.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: These reasons are difficult because they can contain genuine considerations.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The novel asks what happens when an explanation becomes sufficient by definition.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Whose account must change, and whose loss must remain uncounted?

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Mara's investigation tests the institution's confidence through particular cases.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Its official descriptions become part of the mechanism Mara must investigate.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Understanding more can become an ethical achievement or an institutional defense.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The opening note explicitly offers two ways into this book.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The ordinary route begins with the lamp and proceeds room by room.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The final chapter, Whale Within Whale, can also be read independently.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: It approaches the world through altered perception and uncertain observers.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: That option changes the reading route without making its uncertainties disappear.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: For the patient institutional mystery, start with Mara's first working day.
